name: EPIC 211440105
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 16, 7.7 solar radii and 1.31 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211440105 (K2 campaign 16): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.668513 (16th-84th percentiles 7.390131-7.956602), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,861 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 1.31 solar masses and 7.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,908 K at its surface.
